scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.check:generated: npm run generate && git diff --exit-code src/generated
scripts.typecheck: npm run generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p tsconfig.type-tests.json
scripts.test: npm run generate && vitest run && npm run build && npm run conformance
